title: Image prompt enhancement gets a clearer path through text
summary:
A small builder-friendly day: smoother image prompt enhancement and a clearer map to the SDKs.

Prompt-enhancement requests coming from image.pollinations.ai are no longer caught by the usual text endpoint rate limiting, keeping image generations moving when they need text help behind the scenes. A follow-up fixed the syntax issue in that change, because software enjoys making simple routing rules ceremonial.

The project now has a dedicated SDKs and libraries section, giving builders a more direct route from an idea to code that talks to Pollinations.
